evals.name: rich-plan
evals.prompt: Convert this plan file to a spatial HTML peer alongside it: <ABS_PATH>/test1_rich_plan.md . Keep the markdown unchanged.
evals.expected_output: A new .html file at <ABS_PATH>/test1_rich_plan.html. It preserves the markdown content as escaped HTML, has no unreplaced placeholders or external assets, keeps the footer attribution, preserves the code block, and renders the File layout section with figure.modmap containing inline SVG.

evals.name: linked-pair
evals.prompt: Convert this plan and its companion detail file to spatial HTML peers: <ABS_PATH>/test2_plan.md and <ABS_PATH>/test2_detail.md . Keep both markdown files unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Two new .html files (test2_plan.html, test2_detail.html). Each file preserves its source content as escaped HTML, has no unreplaced placeholders or external assets, links to the other HTML file, and has a footer referencing its own markdown source.

evals.name: prose-rfc-restraint
evals.prompt: Convert this RFC to spatial HTML: <ABS_PATH>/test3_rfc.md . Keep the markdown unchanged.
evals.expected_output: A spatial HTML peer at test3_rfc.html. Since the RFC is mostly prose with only one decision section and one small comparison, it uses restraint: decision/comparison styling is allowed, but fabricated SVG diagrams are not. Every paragraph is preserved as escaped HTML, with no placeholders, no external assets, and a footer referencing test3_rfc.md.
